I'd make it a little more confident and less self-deprecating. You don't want to lead with "I may not fit the bill." Instead, emphasize the value you'll bring.

:::writing{variant="email" id="58271" subject="Re: Agency Application"}
Hi Jeff,

Thank you for the note and for sharing more about Agency. What you've built is exactly the kind of environment I've been searching for—a room of founders willing to challenge, support, and learn from one another in a meaningful way.

While my business may not look exactly like every other agency in the room, I believe the perspective, experience, and commitment I bring would make me a valuable contributor. I've spent my career solving growth, operational, and leadership challenges in high-pressure environments, and I genuinely enjoy helping others navigate them as well.

I'm excited about the opportunity to be considered and would welcome the chance to share more about my journey, my business, and how I could contribute to the group.

Looking forward to connecting.

Bethany Anne Gifford  
Co-Founder & CEO | The Luxora Collective
Growth Partners for Med Spa Owners Ready to Scale
bethany@theluxoracollective.co
www.theluxoracollective.co
:::

Or, if you want something shorter and more "Bethany":

:::writing{variant="email" id="41863" subject="Re: Agency Application"}
Hi Jeff,

Thank you for the update. I'm genuinely excited about the opportunity to be considered.

While I may come from a slightly different corner of the agency world, I've found that some of the most valuable conversations happen when diverse experiences come together around the same business challenges. I have no doubt I'd be able to contribute meaningfully to the room, and I'd love the opportunity to show you why.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Bethany Anne Gifford
:::

The second version feels stronger because it projects confidence without sounding like you're trying to convince them to take a chance on you.

Respond better and more eloquently: Really excited to have the opportunity to be considered. I may not 100% fit your bill I promise I will once you meet me. 


			Bethany Anne
Co-Founder & CEO | The Luxora Collective
Growth Partners for Med Spa Owners Ready to Scale
📧 bethany@theluxoracollective.co
🌐 www.theluxoracollective.co

    
When your med spa operates at its highest level,
 you create an impact that ripples through
 your entire community.

On Tue, Jun 9, 2026, 8:27 PM Jeff Shannon <jeff@joinagency.co> wrote:
Hey Bethany,

Thanks for applying to Agency.

Here's what happens next:
Our team is reviewing your application over the next couple of days (researching you and your business)
If it looks like a fit, we'll set up a 45-minute conversation, not a sales call, to see if the room is right for you and you're right for the room.
Either way, you'll hear from us within 5 days.
Quick context on why this exists: I run Pilothouse, a 160-person performance marketing agency. Even with a ton of general 'business' options out there, I couldn't find a room where I could put a real agency problem on the table - a margin issue, a hiring fire, a partner conversation going sideways - and get unfiltered input from people who'd actually been through it themselves. So I built the room I wanted.

Agency isn't a networking group. It's a working group of agency owners who treat each other's businesses like their own. Forum groups of 6–8 non-competing founders at your level, a private community of peers, member-only roundtables, and a deal network. The value lives in what gets said in the room, which is why we're careful about who's in it.

One thing worth saying upfront: every member is expected to give as much as they get. If you're hoping to lurk and absorb, this won't be the place. If you want a small group of peers who treat your hardest problems like their own, you're in the right spot.

Talk soon,

Jeff Shannon
Founder, Agency


Note: If you don't want to hear from me again, just click here.
